examples.arabic: قلت له ان الشباب دلوقتي بتحب تلبس الوان كتير في الرياضة
examples.english: I told him that the youth nowadays love to wear many colors in sports.
examples.transliteration: olt loh en el shabab delwaaty betheb telbes alwaan keteer fi el reyada

examples.arabic: اشترينا لها فستان حلو لونه كحلي عشان هي بتحب الوان غامقة
examples.english: We bought her a nice dress, its color is navy blue, because she likes dark colors.
examples.transliteration: eshtareyna laha fostaan helw lono kohli ashan heyya betheb alwaan ghamqa

examples.arabic: شفت الوان كتير حلوه في المحل بس كنت عايز لون غامق
examples.english: I saw many beautiful colors in the shop but I wanted a dark color.
examples.transliteration: shuft alwaan kitir hilwa fi el mahal bas kunt aayiz loon ghaami

examples.arabic: ماما سالتني ايه رايك في الوان الديكور الجديدة دي يا بنتي
examples.english: Mom asked me 'What do you think of these new decor colors, my daughter?'
examples.transliteration: Mama sa'aletni eh ra'yek fi alwan el dikor el gedida di ya binti

examples.arabic: البياع وراني ألوان كتير بس أنا حسيت إن مفيش حاجة عجباني
examples.english: The seller showed me many colors, but I felt that nothing pleased me.
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' warrani alwan keteer bas ana hasset en mafeesh haga 3agbani

examples.arabic: المحل كان كبير اوي وفيه الوان كتير
examples.english: The shop was very big and had many colors.
examples.transliteration: Elmahal kan kabeer awi we fee alwan kiteer.
